en.description: Tell us what’s wrong. Our safety team will review this. We may remove content or restrict accounts that put people at risk.
en.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? Include dates or messages if you can.
en.successDescription: Thanks — our safety team will review this.
en.errorFallback: We could not send your report. Please try again.
en.rateLimited: You’ve sent too many reports. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
en.rateLimitedGeneric: You’ve sent too many reports. Please wait a bit and try again.
en.selfNotAllowed: You can’t report your own listing.
en.targetNotFound: We couldn’t find that listing. It may have been removed.
en.loginRequired: Sign in to send a report.
